```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library('rlang')
library('ggplot2')
library('plyr')
library('plyr')
library('knitr')
```

## CV Results


```{r}
file= "GLOBAL/CV/mergedCV.csv"
dt <- read.csv(file, sep = ",", header=TRUE ) 
#dt[!duplicated(dt)]
dt$cat<-NA
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="CMMS"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="G_H"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="HSV"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="RGB"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="GLCM"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="HRLK"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat[dt$DTYPE =="LBP"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat <- as.factor(dt$cat)
dt$GROUP <- gsub('C', 'G0', dt$GROUP)
head(dt)

```

```{r}
unique(dt$MODEL)
```


```{r}
dt_G<-ddply(dt, c("GROUP", "DTYPE", "cat", "scale"), summarise, #
                 nobs = length(MODEL), 
                 scales = length(unique(scale )),
                 p = round(mean(precision, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 r = round(mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 f1 = round(mean(F1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 f1.m = round(median(F1, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                 f1.sd = round(sd(F1, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
                 )
head(dt_G)
```

```{r}
dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR", ]
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, dpi=300, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
# With a line graph
pd <- position_dodge(.3)
#ggplot(dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR" & dt_G$algorithm=="G_H",], aes(x = as.factor(scale), y = f1, fill=data, group=data)) +
ggplot(dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR", ], aes(x =  as.factor(scale), y = f1, color = DTYPE, group = DTYPE)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = f1 - f1.sd, ymax = f1 + f1.sd), width = .2, size = 0.25,  position = pd
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(shape=DTYPE), position = pd) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=DTYPE), position = pd, size = 2)+scale_shape_manual(values = c(0, 15, 17, 19))+
 # scale_shape_manual(values = c(0, 1, 8, 11, 15, 16, 17,  6))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.7, linetype="dashed", color = "orange")+
  theme_bw() +facet_wrap(vars(GROUP), ncol = 4)+ 
   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), 
           axis.line = element_line(size=1, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", size=0),
           panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d3d3d3"),
           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
           panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 14,  face = "bold"), #family = "Garamond",
           text=element_text(), #family="Garamond"
           axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour="black", size = 9),
           axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size = 9)
         ) +
  labs(x = "Scale (%)", y = "F1-score", subtitle='Color features')
#ggsave("global_color.png", dpi = 300)
ggsave("global_color.eps", dpi = 300)
```
